boundary: Dimensions are verified exactly by modular linear algebra at a good characteristic prime not dividing 40. The cubic maps are covariants of the single faithful 4D normalizer module. They do not by themselves construct a full-carrier PSp(4,3)-equivariant nonlinear coupling.

theorem: For the faithful four-dimensional 5:8 module with central sign -1, scalar invariants occur only in even degree and equivariant polynomial self-maps only in odd degree. There is no quadratic scalar invariant and no quadratic/cubic scalar coupling; however the first genuinely nonlinear equivariant self-maps already occur in degree three. Thus the linear Hom obstruction does not forbid projective cubic normalizer-covariant dynamics, although this remains a subgroup-level construction rather than a full PSp(4,3)-equivariant E8-to-coexact map.
